name: @mixdog/mobile
description: Mixdog phone app: a thin Capacitor shell (iOS + Android) around the relay web app, with native APNs/FCM push.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run verify:native && npm run build:web
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
